description_en: Queries the status of report contacts by using the system configuration and security report feature of Security Center
description_zh: 使用云安全中心的系统配置，安全报告功能查询报告联系人状态
name: DescribeReportRecipientStatus

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The email addresses of the contacts. Separate multiple email addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 联系人邮箱，多个用半角逗号隔开
parameters.name: recipients

items.description_en: The information about a report contact

IsVerify.description_en:
The verification status. Valid values:

0: Not verified.
1: Verified.

If the email address is not added to the security report, the return value is empty
IsVerify.description_zh:
是否验证标识。取值：

0：未验证
1：已验证

邮箱如果没有录入安全报告，返回值为空

Recipient.description_en:
The email address of the contact.

If the email address is not added to the security report, the return value is empty
Recipient.description_zh:
联系人邮箱。

邮箱如果没有录入安全报告，返回值为空

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
